Title: Session token not refreshed after SSO login
Description: Users signing in through the SSO provider are redirected back to the app but the session token is dropped, so the dashboard immediately bounces them back to the login page.
Severity: High
Component: Authentication
Environment: Staging
Error: TypeError: cannot read property 'access_token' of undefined
Stack_trace: at handleCallback (auth/callback.js:42:19)
    at processRedirect (auth/session.js:17:8)
